port.name: micro
port.description: Living Code for micro: native color-link schemes for syntax groups, editor chrome, selections, diagnostics and search matches.

guide.installation:
```sh
git clone https://github.com/living-code-theme/micro.git
cd micro
```

```sh
mkdir -p "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/micro/colorschemes"
cp themes/*.micro "${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/micro/colorschemes/"
```

Open micro, press **Ctrl+E**, and run `set colorscheme living-code-night`. If your terminal’s truecolor support is not detected, also run `set truecolor on`.
guide.configuration: The `.micro` files contain only native `color-link` directives. Default body colors, selected text, status lines, tabs, cursor line, search and trailing whitespace are explicitly configured. Built-in syntax subgroups preserve string/number/boolean and operator distinctions. `identifier.class` is used by some micro grammars for functions as well as classes, so it follows the function role.
guide.compatibility: For micro’s documented color-link format, with truecolor enabled for exact hex colors. In reduced-color terminals micro approximates the palette. Highlight precision depends on the filetype’s built-in syntax rules: the colorscheme does not install new grammars. Tests validate directive grammar, native group names and semantic colors.
